products.title: SABRENT OmniPort C7 7-Port USB-C Hub, 10Gbps, Individual Power Switches (HB-CUP7)
products.body_html:
The Sabrent OmniPort C7 is a 7-port USB Type-C hub for people with more USB-C devices than ports. Turn one USB-C connection into seven USB-C ports at up to 10Gbps, then run storage, keyboards, mice, lights, fans, gamepads and other USB-C gear at the same time.

Individual control: Every port has its own power switch and blue LED, so you decide exactly what is powered. Switch a device off when you are not using it, or power-cycle a single port without disturbing the rest.

Power when you need it: For high-draw devices like portable SSDs, connect your own USB-C PD charger to the USB-C PD 3.0 input (up to 100W) and the hub shares that power across its ports, supporting BC1.2 up to 5V/3A per port.

Please note: a power adapter is not included. Use any USB-C PD charger you already own (65W or higher recommended) for high-draw devices.

Features

  • Seven USB-C ports at 10Gbps: Expand one USB-C connection into seven USB-C ports with transfer speeds up to 10Gbps (backward compatible at 5Gbps, 1Gbps and 480Mbps). The included 10Gbps USB-C cable delivers full speed when plugged into a 10Gbps host port.
  • Individual power switch and blue LED on every port: Turn any connected device on or off, or power-cycle a single port, without unplugging anything.
  • Add up to 100W with USB-C PD 3.0: The dedicated PD input accepts up to 100W to feed power-hungry gear like portable SSDs and NVMe enclosures. Power adapter not included.
  • Use all your USB-C gear at once: Keyboards, mice, flash drives, portable drives, fans, LED lights, gamepads and more. Compact and lightweight for a tidy desk or for travel.
  • Plug and play, no drivers: Works with Windows, macOS, Linux, iPadOS and Android.

In the box

  • Sabrent OmniPort C7 7-Port USB-C Hub (HB-CUP7)
  • 10Gbps USB-C cable

Backed by Sabrent's 1-year warranty, extendable to 2 years with free registration on our website.

products.title: BLOWZER X6 - Powerful Airflow, Endless Possibilities
products.body_html:
The SABRENT BLOWZER X6 is a cordless electric air duster and handheld blower — a rechargeable, reusable alternative to disposable canned air. A brushless motor spins up to 130,000 RPM and moves air at up to 45 m/s, powered by a built-in 4000 mAh battery that charges over USB-C.

How much BLOWZER do you need?

  • Gentle — 40,000 RPM for keyboards, electronics and delicate parts
  • Boost — 80,000 RPM for everyday dust on desks, vents and car interiors
  • Blowzer Mode — 130,000 RPM for heavier debris: sand, leaves, crumbs, workshop mess

One button steps through the modes. Blue indicator LEDs show the mode you're in.

One BLOWZER. Endless possibilities.

  • Clean — PCs, GPUs, keyboards, electronics and workspaces
  • Dry — car mirrors, grilles and emblems: the water a towel can't reach
  • Clear — sand, crumbs, leaves and loose workshop debris
  • Inflate — air mattresses and pool toys
  • Start — charcoal and campfire embers, outdoors, following the safety rules

Aim it your way.

Five interchangeable nozzles shape the air for the job:

  • Default — focused, all-round airflow
  • Wide — a broader sweep for surfaces and panels
  • Long — extra reach into deep gaps and cases
  • Flat — a flat blade of air for tracks, vents and seams
  • Needle — fine, pinpoint air for the tightest spots

Less bulk. More BLOWZER.

149.2 mm (5.9 in) tall with a 40 mm barrel — small enough to live in a desk drawer, backpack or glove box, powerful enough to work everywhere.

BLOWZER travels first class.

Your BLOWZER X6 and its nozzles ride together in a carrying case with fitted foam, a mesh pocket and a zip closure.

Specifications

  • Model: TF-BZX6 · UPC 840025274754
  • Motor: brushless, up to 130,000 RPM
  • Speed modes: 3 — Gentle 40K / Boost 80K / Blowzer Mode 130K RPM
  • Airflow velocity: up to 45 m/s
  • Battery: 4000 mAh, built in
  • Charging: USB-C with smart power management and auto-shutoff
  • Indicators: blue mode LEDs and battery-level lights
  • Nozzles: five, interchangeable
  • Size: 149.2 mm tall, 40 mm barrel; body 64.1 mm, 92.2 mm with the default nozzle (5.9 × 3.6 × 1.6 in)

In the box

  • BLOWZER X6 cordless air duster
  • Five interchangeable nozzles
  • Cleaning brushes
  • USB Type-A to Type-C charging cable
  • Carrying case

Warranty

2-year SABRENT limited warranty — extended to 3 years when you register within 90 days of purchase at sabrent.com/support.

Use it right

  • PCs: power off and unplug, start on Gentle, and hold fan blades still while you blow them clean.
  • Never point it at people, pets, faces or eyes. Not a toy — store it out of reach of children and pets.
  • Keep the unit away from liquids and never submerge it.
  • Never use it around flammable gases or vapors, or with lighter fluid.
  • Charge before use; don't run it while it's charging.

products.title: Rocket Enterprise PCIe 4.0 U.2 NVMe SSD
products.body_html:
• The Rocket Enterprise PCIe 4.0 U.2 NVMe SSD (SB-P4U2) is the singular high-performance, high-endurance storage solution for demanding enterprise workloads. It’s built to survive in tough environments with consistent performance.
  • The Rocket Enterprise is available from 1.92TB to 30.72TB at up to 7,000/6,800 MB/s for sequential R/W performance and up to 1,600K/180K IOPS for 4K random reads and writes. Sustained QD1 4K RND as low as 90µs/15µs.
  • This SSD is built to withstand up to one drive write per day (DWPD) at up to over 56PBW with the 30.72TB model. UBER is at <1 sector per 10^18 bits read with an MTBF of 2.5M hours. The drive is also durable to survive various environments.
  • This is not your usual retail consumer SSD. It supports E2E metadata protection, namespaces, and power loss protection (PLP) as well as NVMe-MI over SMBus and VPD. The drive also has intelligent thermal management to protect data.
  • TAA Compliance: Compliance with the Trade Agreements Act (TAA), helps ease procurement in US Federal Government

The Sabrent OmniPort C7 is a 7-port USB Type-C hub for people with more USB-C devices than ports. Turn one USB-C connection into seven USB-C ports at up to 10Gbps, then run storage, keyboards, mice, lights, fans, gamepads and other USB-C gear at the same time.

Individual control: Every port has its own power switch and blue LED, so you decide exactly what is powered. Switch a device off when you are not using it, or power-cycle a single port without disturbing the rest.

Power when you need it: For high-draw devices like portable SSDs, connect your own USB-C PD charger to the USB-C PD 3.0 input (up to 100W) and the hub shares that power across its ports, supporting BC1.2 up to 5V/3A per port.

Please note: a power adapter is not included. Use any USB-C PD charger you already own (65W or higher recommended) for high-draw devices.

Features

  • Seven USB-C ports at 10Gbps: Expand one USB-C connection into seven USB-C ports with transfer speeds up to 10Gbps (backward compatible at 5Gbps, 1Gbps and 480Mbps). The included 10Gbps USB-C cable delivers full speed when plugged into a 10Gbps host port.
  • Individual power switch and blue LED on every port: Turn any connected device on or off, or power-cycle a single port, without unplugging anything.
  • Add up to 100W with USB-C PD 3.0: The dedicated PD input accepts up to 100W to feed power-hungry gear like portable SSDs and NVMe enclosures. Power adapter not included.
  • Use all your USB-C gear at once: Keyboards, mice, flash drives, portable drives, fans, LED lights, gamepads and more. Compact and lightweight for a tidy desk or for travel.
  • Plug and play, no drivers: Works with Windows, macOS, Linux, iPadOS and Android.

In the box

  • Sabrent OmniPort C7 7-Port USB-C Hub (HB-CUP7)
  • 10Gbps USB-C cable

Backed by Sabrent's 1-year warranty, extendable to 2 years with free registration on our website.

X6 - Powerful Airflow, Endless Possibilities","handle":"tf-bzx6","body_html":"

The SABRENT BLOWZER X6 is a cordless electric air duster and handheld blower — a rechargeable, reusable alternative to disposable canned air. A brushless motor spins up to 130,000 RPM and moves air at up to 45 m/s, powered by a built-in 4000 mAh battery that charges over USB-C.

How much BLOWZER do you need?

  • Gentle — 40,000 RPM for keyboards, electronics and delicate parts
  • Boost — 80,000 RPM for everyday dust on desks, vents and car interiors
  • Blowzer Mode — 130,000 RPM for heavier debris: sand, leaves, crumbs, workshop mess

One button steps through the modes. Blue indicator LEDs show the mode you're in.

One BLOWZER. Endless possibilities.

  • Clean — PCs, GPUs, keyboards, electronics and workspaces
  • Dry — car mirrors, grilles and emblems: the water a towel can't reach
  • Clear — sand, crumbs, leaves and loose workshop debris
  • Inflate — air mattresses and pool toys
  • Start — charcoal and campfire embers, outdoors, following the safety rules

Aim it your way.

Five interchangeable nozzles shape the air for the job:

  • Default — focused, all-round airflow
  • Wide — a broader sweep for surfaces and panels
  • Long — extra reach into deep gaps and cases
  • Flat — a flat blade of air for tracks, vents and seams
  • Needle — fine, pinpoint air for the tightest spots

Less bulk. More BLOWZER.

149.2 mm (5.9 in) tall with a 40 mm barrel — small enough to live in a desk drawer, backpack or glove box, powerful enough to work everywhere.

BLOWZER travels first class.

Your BLOWZER X6 and its nozzles ride together in a carrying case with fitted foam, a mesh pocket and a zip closure.

Specifications

  • Model: TF-BZX6 · UPC 840025274754
  • Motor: brushless, up to 130,000 RPM
  • Speed modes: 3 — Gentle 40K / Boost 80K / Blowzer Mode 130K RPM
  • Airflow velocity: up to 45 m/s
  • Battery: 4000 mAh, built in
  • Charging: USB-C with smart power management and auto-shutoff
  • Indicators: blue mode LEDs and battery-level lights
  • Nozzles: five, interchangeable
  • Size: 149.2 mm tall, 40 mm barrel; body 64.1 mm, 92.2 mm with the default nozzle (5.9 × 3.6 × 1.6 in)

In the box

  • BLOWZER X6 cordless air duster
  • Five interchangeable nozzles
  • Cleaning brushes
  • USB Type-A to Type-C charging cable
  • Carrying case

Warranty

2-year SABRENT limited warranty — extended to 3 years when you register within 90 days of purchase at sabrent.com/support.

Use it right

  • PCs: power off and unplug, start on Gentle, and hold fan blades still while you blow them clean.
  • Never point it at people, pets, faces or eyes. Not a toy — store it out of reach of children and pets.
  • Keep the unit away from liquids and never submerge it.
  • Never use it around flammable gases or vapors, or with lighter fluid.
  • Charge before use; don't run it while it's charging.

  • The Rocket Enterprise PCIe 4.0 U.2 NVMe SSD (SB-P4U2) is the singular high-performance, high-endurance storage solution for demanding enterprise workloads. It’s built to survive in tough environments with consistent performance.
  • The Rocket Enterprise is available from 1.92TB to 30.72TB at up to 7,000/6,800 MB/s for sequential R/W performance and up to 1,600K/180K IOPS for 4K random reads and writes. Sustained QD1 4K RND as low as 90µs/15µs.
  • This SSD is built to withstand up to one drive write per day (DWPD) at up to over 56PBW with the 30.72TB model. UBER is at <1 sector per 10^18 bits read with an MTBF of 2.5M hours. The drive is also durable to survive various environments.
  • This is not your usual retail consumer SSD. It supports E2E metadata protection, namespaces, and power loss protection (PLP) as well as NVMe-MI over SMBus and VPD. The drive also has intelligent thermal management to protect data.
  • TAA Compliance: Compliance with the Trade Agreements Act (TAA), helps ease procurement in US Federal Government

Title"]}]},{"id":8032956580097,"title":"4-Drive M.2 NVMe SSD to PCIe 3.0 x4 Adapter Card","handle":"ec-p3x4","body_html":"⦁ Add up to four NVMe SSDs using only one PCIe slot.
⦁ Designed for use with M.2 2280 form factor SSDs.
⦁ Compatible with PCIe 3.0 motherboards and backward compatible with PCIe 2.0 / 1.0.
⦁ Aluminum construction for maximum heat dissipation and optimal performance.
⦁ Ample support for legacy motherboards.
⦁ Fits in PCIe x4, x8, or x16 slots, but not PCIe x1 slots.
⦁ Compliant with sleep states S3 and S4.
⦁ Active State Power Management (ASPM) protocol capable of L0s / L1 / L23 / L3 power states.
⦁ L1 sub-states added to the PCIe specification to reach SSD power consumption goals and minimize latency.
⦁ Latency Tolerance Reporting (LTR) enables lower power and longer exit latency power states.
⦁ Advanced Error Reporting (AER) capability for a more robust PCI Express implementation.

Title"]}]},{"id":8011966644481,"title":"4-Drive M.2 NVMe SSD to PCIe 4.0 x16 Bifurcation Adapter Card with Active Cooling","handle":"ec-p4bf","body_html":"
  • Add up to four high-performance NVMe SSDs to a system with a single adapter in a physical x16 PCIe slot.
  • The system requires the PCIe bifurcation (lane splitting) function to add more than one SSD with a full 16 lanes (x4/x4/x4/x4) required for 3 or 4 drives (x8/x8 or x4/x4 for two).
  • Supports even the fastest PCIe 4.0 SSDs but also works with older and newer generation SSDs at up to 4.0 speeds.
  • Works in older 3.0/2.0 systems that have PCIe bifurcation support. Compatible with NVMe SSDs in the M.2 2230/2242/2260/2280 form factors for your convenience.
  • Designed with quality aluminum for physical stability and top-notch cooling. Thermal padding is included to ensure the best cooling interface for your SSDs.
  • Optional active cooling (fan) via a rear-positioned switch for high-performance environments. Your drives won’t throttle in here.
  • The card is plug and play with no drivers required. Supports Intel® VROC and AMD Ryzen™ NVMe RAID with their respective limitations.

    • Supports: The XTRM-Q and Nano portable SSDs, plus the EC-NVMe enclosure. The CFexpress Type B (CR-CFER) and SD Express 7.1 (CR-SDX7) memory card readers are also supported.
